signal_evidence.housing_demand: Mortgage rates are still far too high and listings are at all-time highs... in a housing market that was supposed to break us.
signal_evidence.capex_direction: Fixed operating expenses were $33 million in Q1, down $2 million quarter-over-quarter and down $6 million year-over-year... We are holding the fixed cost base flat while simultaneously investing in AI and infrastructure.
signal_evidence.pricing_power: 40 million homeowners in this country want to move in the next 12 months, but only 1 in 5 think they can actually do it... The broader market was at 23% [homes >120 days] two quarters ago and rose to 33% at the end of Q1.
signal_evidence.management_tone_shift: We now have a few more months of data... 4 consecutive months tell us something October alone could not. This isn't an accident. This isn't small sample luck... It gives me confidence.
